summary: Invesco Commercial Real Estate Finance Trust, a non-traded Maryland REIT, filed a routine Item 8.01 8-K on September 16, 2026, disclosing monthly net asset value as of August 31, 2026 and the resulting October 1, 2026 transaction price. Total NAV was approximately $1.43 billion across seven share classes, with NAV per share ranging from $24.8879 (Class D) to $26.2046 (Class F); roughly 56.8 million shares were outstanding. No board recommendation, advisor, strategic action, tender, acquisition, or special-situation event is disclosed; this is an ordinary periodic NAV update under the company's valuation guidelines, so no deal terms apply.
